clips.title: Thinking of Getting a Pet
grammar: 〜てくれる — doing something for someone's benefit

lines.ja: いきなりやけど俺、ちょっともうペット飼いたいな思て。
lines.en: Out of nowhere, but I've been thinking I'd like to get a pet.
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: 一人暮らしの寂しさとか紛らわしてくれるやんか。
lines.en: It takes your mind off the loneliness of living alone, you know?
lines.speaker: Friend

clips.title: Is This Supposed to Be Funny?
grammar: 〜ても — even if / no matter what

lines.ja: 人の真似すんの死んでも嫌やって言うてましたよね？
lines.en: You told me you'd rather die than copy someone else, right?
lines.speaker: Tokunaga

lines.ja: これも面白いんですか？
lines.en: Is this supposed to be funny too?
lines.speaker: Tokunaga

clips.title: There Is No Bad Ending
grammar: まだまだ — still far from / still

lines.ja: 生きている限り、バッドエンドはない。
lines.en: As long as you're alive, there is no bad ending.
lines.speaker: Tokunaga

lines.ja: 僕たちはまだまだ途中だ。
lines.en: We are still on our way.
lines.speaker: Tokunaga
